    str, str], token: Dict[str, Any], state: 'BlockState', rules: List[str]
    ) ->Optional[Tuple[str, str, str]]:
    leading_spaces, marker, text = groups
    leading_width = len(leading_spaces) + len(marker)
    text, continue_width = _compile_continue_width(text, leading_width)

    pattern = _compile_list_item_pattern(bullet, leading_width)
    item_pattern = re.compile(pattern, re.M)

    src = state.src
    pos = state.cursor
    children = []
    if text:
        children.append(text)

    next_groups = None

    while pos < len(src):
        newline_pos = src.find('\n', pos)
        if newline_pos == -1:
            line = src[pos:]
            next_pos = len(src)
        else:
            line = src[pos:newline_pos]
            next_pos = newline_pos + 1

        m = item_pattern.match(line)
        if m:
            state.cursor = next_pos
            next_groups = (m.group('listitem_1'), m.group('listitem_2'), m.group('listitem_3'))
            break

        if not line.strip():
            children.append('\n')
            pos = next_pos
            state.cursor = next_pos
            continue

        expanded = expand_leading_tab(line, 3)
        expanded = expand_tab(expanded)
        trim_space = ' ' * continue_width
        if expanded.startswith(trim_space):
            children.append(expanded[continue_width:] + '\n')
            pos = next_pos
            state.cursor = next_pos
        else:
            break

    item_src = ''.join(children)
    item_src = strip_end(item_src) + '\n'

    child_state = state.__class__()
    child_state.src = item_src
    child_state.tokens = []
    block.parse(item_src, child_state, rules)

    if _is_loose_list(child_state.tokens):
        token['tight'] = False

    list_item: Dict[str, Any] = {'type': 'list_item', 'children': child_state.tokens}
    token['children'].append(list_item)

    return next_groups
